title: Fake Papoose
description: Fake Papoose is the alias for Jurgen Mantzke creating music
paragraphs: Fake Papoose is the alias I create music under. I have created thirteen tracks in GarageBand since 2024, and I continue to compose new songs. This is a sampling of six curated tracks from my body of work.
I do not sing, so any vocals in my songs are samples taken from podcasts, movies, tv shows and video games.

My inspiration comes from the industrial and EBM music I have listened to most of my life. The strongest influences are Juno Reactor, Front 242, Front Line Assembly, Nitzer Ebb, Meat Beat Manifesto, and Circle of Dust.

This is a hobby project, and the vinyl turntable here is an experiment to see how complex of a feature I can create with vibe-coding. I designed everything and used Claude Opus to construct it. The tracks themselves use zero AI for composition.
